display.title: Rabbi Akiva and Netilas Yadayim in Prison
display.summary_short: Jailed for teaching Torah and given no water for three days, Rabbi Akiva uses his jug of water to wash negel vasser, and the astonished ruler sets him free.
display.summary_long: Despite the danger, Rabbi Akiva kept teaching Torah in public, and he was thrown into a crowded cell with criminals. The cruel wardens gave the prisoners no food or water for three long days. When jugs of water were finally brought in, the ruler happened to pass by and watched the prisoners gulp it down. Only Rabbi Akiva did not drink: he poured the precious water over his fingers to wash negel vasser and made a brachah. Amazed, the ruler had him given another jug of water, released from the cell and brought to the palace. While the other prisoners were punished, Rabbi Akiva was freed, and the ruler soon made him an advisor. Uncle Yossi draws the lesson: Rabbi Akiva served Hashem with all his heart and soul, and when we keep mitzvos with firm belief, Hashem blesses us with success.
display.lesson: Keep the mitzvos with firm belief even when it is hard, and Hashem will bless you with success.
